description.summary: This spell functions as Reality Rift except as above
description.value: This spell functions as Reality Rift except as above. In addition, even if the creature succeeds it save, it still disappears for 1 round/3 levels. However, if it fails its save, it is inflicted with the Banished status effect permenantly, it is permanently removed from reality, disappearing forever. It cannot be resurrected, because it is not dead–it simply does not exist. Only a miracle, wish, or another effect of equal power can bring back a creature whose existence has been negated in this way. Once a creature has been affected by or saved against this effect it is immune to it for 24 hours.
